data: Is the value of the blue line consistently higher than the red line in the rightmost plot?

The rightmost plot shows the average results for non-inference tasks. The blue line represents the MLM model, the red line represents the NSP model, and the yellow line represents the Split model. 

To determine if the blue line is consistently higher than the red line, I will compare their positions across the entire range of the x-axis:

1. At the beginning of the x-axis (approximately at 1 billion tokens):
   - The blue line starts above the red line.

2. As we move along the x-axis:
   - The blue line remains consistently above the red line until approximately 7 billion tokens.
   - After 7 billion tokens, the blue line dips below the red line and remains below it until the end of the x-axis.

Therefore, the blue line is not consistently higher than the red line in the rightmost plot. It is only consistently higher up to approximately 7 billion tokens.
